verdict.rationale: Proa documents an official CLI, installed with `cargo install proa-cli --locked`. `proa new site hello-proa --yes` scaffolds a minimal Axum-backed app, and a kitchen-sink starter is offered as the fastest way to see a full app. A dev server then runs on localhost:3000 and restarts on file changes, which covers scaffold-and-run. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end setup time (the 'few minutes' claim), and the exact run command is not quoted in the evidence.
